messages:
shera: quick sync — Zephyr POC go/no-go checklist for next Tue. Need final confirm on integration deliverables and who owns SSO + data masking. @tayla can you confirm eng cutover ETA?
ashwin: i'm on SSO; final tests tomorrow AM. still need ok on cert rotation from infra.
tayla: working on the webhook retry/backoff fix, PR up: https://github.com/redwood/zephyr/pull/342 — pinged @ben for validation on behavior.
ben: saw the PR, looks fine, need a short note on rollback behavior. also product needs success criteria: 95% classification recall on sample dataset.
ashwin: noted for rollback — will add a config flag: `ENABLE_ZEPHYR_ROLLBACK=true` and doc snippet:
```
# enable rollback window (mins)
ZEPHYR_ROLLBACK_WINDOW=30
```
samir: re: data masking — legal needs confirmation that pii fields are tokenized, status: in progress with DQ team.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: infra ok, capacity reserved on dedicated pool (pool-7), no infra blockers.
shera: owners summary: SSO=ashwin, webhooks=tayla, data-masking=samir, prod rollout=ben. Please ack and update any missing deps.
tayla: acked. ETA for webhook fix still WIP, target deploy window Mon 4-6pm PT. need one more code review.
ashwin: i'll review PR by EOD and add integration tests to CI (quick smoke).
ben: I'll own the go/no-go call Tue 9am PT; prepare brief runbook and fallback plan. @shera can you draft runbook bullets?
shera: drafting now, will drop runbook link here by EOD. quick Q — do we need a canary in eu-west region or single region is ok?
samir: recommend canary in eu-west for latency/regional compliance. can do 10% traffic shift.
ashwin: agree, set routing policy to: primary=us-west, canary=eu-west 10% for 1hr.
ben: sounds good — last ask: QA to validate sample flows. @ops-bot can you trigger a staging smoke after PR merge?
ops-bot: acknowledged — will run smoke suite automatically on merge to main (suite: zephyr-smoke v2).
shera: thanks everyone — will update thread with runbook link and final checklist once edits done. :thumbsup:
